{{Vanilla|Campfire}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Kindling''' is a block used to cook [[food]] without fuel. It replaces the {{MCW|Campfire|campfire}} and is the first cooking station a player can build. It cooks every food an [[oven]] can except the five oven meals, and it also dries grass and fires clay.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Kindling is crafted from 2 sticks and 2 logs, and always comes out unlit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/campfire.json}}</ref> The vanilla campfire recipe (which used coal or charcoal) is removed.

=== Breaking ===
Kindling always drops itself, unlit, instead of charcoal.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/campfire.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Kindling has to be lit, for example with [[tinder]] or a [[Fire Starter|fire starter]], before it can cook. Lighting it grants ''Prometheus be Damned''.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/light_campfire.json}}</ref>

=== Cooking ===
{{Main|Cooking}}
Up to four items cook at once. Food takes 10 seconds (200 ticks), a third of a vanilla campfire's 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/campfire/cooked_beef.json}}</ref> It cooks:
* The simple preparations of [[intrinsic]] ingredients, including [[Popped Chorus Fruit|popped chorus fruit]] and [[Dried Kelp|dried kelp]].
* [[Bread]], [[Baked Potato|baked potato]]es, [[Fried Egg|fried egg]]s, [[nopales]], [[molasses]] and cooked meat and fish.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/campfire/molasses.json}}</ref>

The oven meals ([[Green Curry|green curry]], [[Japanese Curry|Japanese curry]], [[Paneer Makhani|paneer makhani]], [[Pumpkin Curry|pumpkin curry]] and [[Tonkotsu Ramen|tonkotsu ramen]]) can't be cooked on kindling; their [[stock]]s cook only in an [[oven]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/pumpkin_curry.json}}</ref>

It also dries grass and bushes and fires clay balls into bricks:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/campfire/short_dry_grass_campfire.json}}</ref>
{{Data/Station/Kindling}}
Firing clay and drying tall grass, a large fern or a bush take 5 seconds, and drying short grass or a fern 10 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/campfire/brick_campfire.json}}</ref> Drying grass grants ''Harvester''.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Prometheus be Damned'': light kindling using tinder or a fire starter.
* ''Harvester'': use a hoe to harvest grass and dry it on kindling.

{{History line|0.5-alpha|Cooking food on a campfire gives the matching recipe unlocks.}}

{{History line|1.12.5|Kindling no longer cooks the oven meals (the curries and tonkotsu ramen); they cook only in an oven.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Ramen and Curries can no longer cooked on campfires}}</ref>}}
